s: Burning Sun is a narrative-driven adventure game set on an ancient holy city of Igra struck by a mysterious crisis: sun has been suddenly turned to eleven. Even a second too long in the sun and you will be burnt to crisp. Enduring the relentless heat, it is up to you to explore the city by dashing from shadow to shadow, aquiring tools and evading bone-crushing golems.
